name: amazon-keyword-competitor-monitor
description: Amazon 关键词竞品价格与排名监控系统
author: Amazon Monitor Team

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/shared run test && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/agent run test && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/api run test:unit && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run test && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/desktop run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/api run build && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run build
scripts.test:release-gates: vitest run scripts/verify-signature.test.mjs scripts/verify-signatures.test.mjs scripts/release-evidence.test.mjs scripts/verify-package.test.mjs scripts/release-workflow.test.mjs scripts/ensure-playwright-browser.test.mjs --silent
scripts.agent:eval: npm run build:shared && npm run build:agent && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/agent run eval:gold --
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:agent && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/api run build && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/web run build && npm --workspace @amazon-monitor/desktop run build
scripts.build:release: npm run clean:build && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run build:release && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run test:openapi-routes && npm run verify:openapi-routes && npm run verify:web-bundle && npm run test:unit -- --silent && npm run verify:sp-api-fixture-shadow && npm run verify:sp-api-recovery-shadow && npm run test:shadow-evidence && npm run verify:sp-api-shadow-evidence -- scripts/fixtures/sp-api-shadow-evidence.example.json --allow-example && npm run verify:db-backup-drill && npm run test:release-gates && npm run test:browser && npm run audit:production
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:package && npm run verify:web-bundle && npm run verify:signature && npm run verify:package-runtime
scripts.verify:release:win: npm run verify:package && npm run verify:web-bundle && npm run verify:signatures -- --installer && npm run verify:package-runtime && npm run verify:package-agent-runtime && npm run verify:package-notification-runtime && npm run verify:package-api-recovery && npm run verify:package-agent-crawler-recovery
